newsitem.title: USA: US Midwest direct hogs seen flat-off $0.50-private.
newsitem.headline: US Midwest direct hogs seen flat-off $0.50-private.

text.p: U.S. Midwest direct cash hog prices on Monday were seen steady to $0.50 per cwt lower amid light demand from packers fighting unprofitable operating margins, livestock dealers and packer buyers said.
Sales were light on Thursday as the industry started winding down before the Independence Day holiday on Friday, they said.

Major U.S. hog slaughter and pork processing plants will be closed on Friday in observance of the holiday. Light slaughter was planned for Saturday and relatively light operations were also seen for Monday, trade sources said.

Interior Iowa and southern Minnesota top prices for hogs delivered to the plant could range $59.50 to $60.00 and Illinois top prices at the plant were seen $58.50 to $59.00, dealers in those areas said.
Indiana/Ohio top hog prices at plants could span $59.50 to $60.00, sources said.
